jobs.title: SALES ASSOCIATE (M/W) – Déc 26 to April 27 - 100%

titleByLocale.it: SALES ASSOCIATE (M/F) – dal 26 al 27 aprile al 100%

jobs.description:
About
Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

For the winter season, we are looking for a Sales Associate to join our St. Moritz boutique and contribute to both an exceptional client experience and strong commercial performance.

Job Description
Mission
• Welcome and advise local and international clients with warmth, confidence and authenticity.
• Understand client needs and recommend products combining style, performance and service.
• Contribute actively to sales targets, KPIs, clienteling and repeat business.
• Develop strong product knowledge and share Fusalp’s heritage, craftsmanship and technical expertise.
• Maintain impeccable visual merchandising and boutique standards.
• Contribute to all daily boutique operations: stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and cash handling.

At Fusalp, everyone contributes to the success of the boutique, whatever the task.

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed :

St. Moritz welcomes a highly international and demanding clientele. We are therefore looking for someone who genuinely enjoys selling, building relationships and working in a fast-paced premium retail environment.

Winter in St. Moritz is intense and highly international. You will spend most of your time with clients, but everyone contributes to the life of the boutique. Sales, clienteling, stock, deliveries and presentation standards are a shared responsibility.

Must-have :
• A first successful customer-facing experience, ideally in retail, fashion, premium hospitality or another environment where service and sales are central.
• A genuine interest in selling, you enjoy approaching clients, understanding their needs and working towards commercial targets.
• Professionalism, reliability and a hands-on attitude.
• Comfort working in a fast-paced, highly international environment.
• The ability to commit fully from 1 December 2026 to 15 April 2027, including weekends, public holidays and peak trading periods.

Nice-to-have :
• Previous experience in premium or luxury retail.
• Additional languages suited to an international clientele.
• Experience with clienteling, CRM or retail KPIs.
• An interest in fashion, ski, mountain lifestyle or technical apparel.

What you’ll love working here :
• A seasonal 100% contract from 1 December 2026 to 15 April 2027.
• Product and client-experience training.
• CHF 4,400 per month + bonus.
• The opportunity to join Fusalp in one of the world's most iconic Alpine destinations.
• The opportunity to strengthen your premium retail expertise within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Temporary (Between 5 and 5 months)
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: St. Moritz
• Experience: > 2 years
• Salary: 4682€ / month

jobs.title: ASSISTANT STORE MANAGER (M/W) - FRENCH & ENGLISH
jobs.description:
About
Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

This role supports our Verbier team during the winter season, when the boutique welcomes a highly international clientele and trading intensity increases significantly..

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Assistant Store Manager to join our Verbier boutique on a permanent basis. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine premium client experience, commercial performance and strong day-to-day support for the boutique team.

While Verbier will be your home boutique, the role also includes regular mobility across our Swiss boutiques when needed to support replacements, reinforcement and business continuity.

You will:
• Lead by example on the sales floor and deliver an exceptional, personalised client experience.
• Drive sales, clienteling and boutique KPIs, turning performance indicators into concrete actions.
• Support the Store Manager in organising daily activity, setting priorities and maintaining strong operational standards.
• Coach and support the team through regular feedback, product knowledge and hands-on guidance.
• Take ownership of the boutique when required, including opening and closing procedures and day-to-day decision-making.
• Ensure Fusalp's visual merchandising and presentation standards are consistently maintained.
• Work alongside the team on stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and all daily boutique operations.
• Provide operational support across other Fusalp boutiques in Switzerland when business needs require it.

At Fusalp, everyone contributes to every aspect of boutique life. Whatever your role, you remain close to our clients and actively involved in the day-to-day operations of the store. As Assistant Store Manager, you lead by example, from selling and clienteling to stock, deliveries, visual merchandising and operational tasks. Leadership starts on the floor.

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed

We are looking for someone who can become operational quickly, bring strong luxury retail expertise and lead from the floor with energy, judgement and a genuine sense of service.

Must-have
• Solid experience in premium or luxury retail, with strong client-facing and commercial responsibilities.
• Previous experience supervising, coaching or supporting a retail team.
• Strong understanding of clienteling, sales targets and retail KPIs.
• Confidence to take ownership, make decisions and support the Store Manager in the daily leadership of the boutique.
• A hands-on mindset: you are as comfortable selling to clients as you are supporting operations and the team.
• French and English is required.
• Flexibility to travel regularly between Fusalp boutiques in Switzerland according to operational needs.

Nice-to-have
• German, Italian or any additional language relevant to our international clientele.
• Experience in luxury fashion, ski, outdoor or performance apparel.
• Previous Assistant Store Manager or senior supervisory experience in a luxury House.

What you’ll love working here
• Permanent 100% contract from 1 December 2026 (42 hours per week).
• CHF 5,500 gross per month, paid over 12 months, plus ASM bonus.
• A role combining a home boutique in Verbier with exposure to our wider Swiss retail network.
• Leadership, product and client-experience development within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Full-Time
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: Val De Bagnes
• Experience: > 5 years
• Salary: 5854€ / month

• Experience in luxury fashion, ski, outdoor or performance apparel.
• Previous Assistant Store Manager or senior supervisory experience in a luxury House.

• Permanent 100% contract from 1 December 2026 (42 hours per week).
• CHF 5,500 gross per month, paid over 12 months, plus ASM bonus.
• A role combining a home boutique in Verbier with exposure to our wider Swiss retail network.
• Leadership, product and client-experience development within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

• Start Date: 01 December 2026

jobs.description:
About
Join the House of Fusalp

Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

This role supports our Gstaad boutique during the winter season. We are looking for a client-facing profile who wants to build a career in premium retail and grow through strong service and commercial performance.

Job Description
• Create a warm, personalised and memorable experience for every client.
• Understand client needs and recommend products, silhouettes and complete looks with confidence.
• Contribute actively to sales targets, KPIs, clienteling and repeat business.
• Share Fusalp's heritage, craftsmanship and technical expertise.
• Maintain impeccable visual merchandising and boutique presentation.
• Take part in all daily operations, including stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and cash handling

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed

For this role, potential and attitude matter, but we still expect a credible first experience facing customers.

Gstaad combines an international clientele with high service expectations. You will spend most of your time facing clients, but everyone also supports stock, deliveries and boutique operations.

Must-have
• A first successful customer-facing experience, ideally in retail, fashion, premium hospitality or another high-quality service environment.
• English is required
• A genuine desire to build a career in retail rather than simply take a seasonal job.
• Enthusiasm for selling, learning and working towards commercial goals.
• Professionalism, reliability and the willingness to contribute wherever the boutique needs you.
• Availability to work a flexible rota, including weekends, public holidays and peak periods.

Nice-to-have
• German, French or any additional language.
• Previous experience in premium or luxury retail.
• Interest in fashion, ski or mountain lifestyle.

What you’ll love working here
• Seasonal 100% contract from December 2026 to the end of March 2027.
• CHF 4,500 per month + bonus. The salary is flexible and may be adjusted based on the candidate’s profile, qualifications, and experience.
• Continuous training in products, client experience and retail excellence.
• The opportunity to gain strong experience in one of Fusalp's key Alpine destinations.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Temporary (Between 4 and 4 months)
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: Saanen
• Experience: > 2 years
• Salary: 4804€ / month

jobs.description: Welcome and advise an international clientele with professionalism, authenticity and attention to detail. Create personalised experiences and build lasting client relationships through clienteling. Contribute actively to sales targets, KPIs and boutique performance. Develop strong knowledge of our collections and confidently share the Fusalp story and technical expertise. Maintain high visual merchandising and boutique presentation standards. Contribute to daily operations, including stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and cash handling. What will help you succeed This opportunity is for someone who wants to develop a real career in premium retail and already has a credible first experience facing customers. Zermatt is an international resort with demanding peak periods. The boutique is a hands-on environment where everyone contributes to clients, sales and operations. Must-have A first successful customer-facing experience, ideally in retail, fashion, premium hospitality or another environment where service and sales are central. English is required. A genuine interest in selling, clienteling and commercial performance. Reliability, professionalism and a hands-on attitude. Availability for an 80% seasonal contract and a flexible rota, including weekends, public holidays and peak periods. Nice-to-have German is highly appreciated. Any additional language. Experience in premium or luxury retail. What you’ll love working here Seasonal 80% contract from December 2026 to 15 April 2027. CHF 3,800 per month + bonus. The salary is flexible and may be adjusted based on the candidate’s profile, qualifications, and experience. Continuous product and retail training. The opportunity to develop your premium retail experience within a growing international House.

descriptionByLocale.it: Benvenuto e consiglia una clientela internazionale con professionalità, autenticità e attenzione ai dettagli. Crea esperienze personalizzate e costruisci relazioni cliente durature attraverso la clientela. Contribuisci attivamente a obiettivi di vendita, KPI e prestazioni boutique. Sviluppare una solida conoscenza delle nostre collezioni e condividere con fiducia la storia di Fusalp e le competenze tecniche. Mantenere elevati standard di merchandising visivo e presentazione boutique. Contribuire alle operazioni giornaliere, comprese le azioni, le consegne, il rifornimento, gli inventari e la gestione dei contanti. Cosa ti aiuterà a riuscire Questa opportunità è per qualcuno che vuole sviluppare una vera e propria carriera nel retail premium e ha già una credibile prima esperienza di fronte ai clienti. Zermatt è un resort internazionale con periodi di picco impegnativi. La boutique è un ambiente pratico in cui tutti contribuiscono a clienti, vendite e operazioni. Must-have Una prima esperienza di successo, idealmente nel retail, nella moda, nell'ospitalità premium o in un altro ambiente in cui il servizio e le vendite sono centrali. L'inglese è richiesto. Un autentico interesse per la vendita, la clientela e le prestazioni commerciali. Affidabilità, professionalità e atteggiamento pratico. Disponibilità per un contratto stagionale dell'80% e un rota flessibile, compresi fine settimana, festivi e periodi di punta. Il tedesco è molto apprezzato. Qualsiasi altra lingua. Esperienza nella vendita al dettaglio premium o di lusso. Ciò che vi piacerà lavorare qui contratto stagionale 80% dal dicembre 2026 al 15 aprile 2027. CHF 3.800 al mese + bonus. Lo stipendio è flessibile e può essere regolato in base al profilo, alle qualifiche e all’esperienza del candidato. Formazione continua di prodotti e vendita al dettaglio. L'opportunità di sviluppare la vostra esperienza di vendita al dettaglio premium all'interno di una crescente casa internazionale.

descriptionByLocale.de: Begrüßen und beraten Sie eine internationale Kundschaft mit Professionalität, Authentizität und Liebe zum Detail. Erstellen Sie personalisierte Erfahrungen und bauen Sie dauerhafte Kundenbeziehungen durch Klienteln auf. Tragen Sie aktiv zu Verkaufszielen, KPIs und Boutique-Performance bei. Entwickeln Sie ein fundiertes Wissen über unsere Kollektionen und teilen Sie die Fusalp-Geschichte und das technische Know-how mit Zuversicht. Halten Sie hohe visuelle Merchandising- und Boutique-Präsentationsstandards. Tragen Sie zum täglichen Betrieb bei, einschließlich Lagerhaltung, Lieferungen, Auffüllung, Lagerbestände und Bargeldabwicklung. Was Ihnen zum Erfolg verhilft Diese Gelegenheit ist für jemanden, der eine echte Karriere im Premium-Einzelhandel entwickeln möchte und bereits eine glaubwürdige erste Erfahrung mit Kunden hat. Zermatt ist ein internationales Resort mit anspruchsvollen Spitzenzeiten. Die Boutique ist eine praktische Umgebung, in der jeder zu Kunden, Verkauf und Betrieb beiträgt. Ein erstes erfolgreiches Kundenerlebnis, idealerweise im Einzelhandel, in der Mode, in der Premium-Gastfreundschaft oder in einer anderen Umgebung, in der Service und Verkauf von zentraler Bedeutung sind. Englisch ist erforderlich. Ein echtes Interesse am Verkauf, der Kundenbindung und der kommerziellen Leistung. Zuverlässigkeit, Professionalität und eine praktische Haltung. Verfügbarkeit für einen saisonalen Vertrag von 80% und eine flexible Rotation, einschließlich Wochenenden, Feiertagen und Hauptverkehrszeiten. Nice-to-have Deutsch wird sehr geschätzt. Jede zusätzliche Sprache. Erfahrung im Premium- oder Luxuseinzelhandel. Was Sie hier lieben werden Saisonal 80% Vertrag vom Dezember 2026 bis 15. April 2027. CHF 3.800 pro Monat + Bonus. Das Gehalt ist flexibel und kann basierend auf dem Profil, den Qualifikationen und der Erfahrung des Kandidaten angepasst werden. Kontinuierliche Produkt- und Einzelhandelsschulungen. Die Möglichkeit, Ihr Premium-Einzelhandelserlebnis in einem wachsenden internationalen Haus zu entwickeln.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Accueillir et conseiller une clientèle internationale avec professionnalisme, authenticité et attention aux détails. Créez des expériences personnalisées et créez des relations client durables grâce au clienteling. Contribuer activement aux objectifs de vente, aux KPI et aux performances des boutiques. Développer une solide connaissance de nos collections et partager avec confiance l'histoire de Fusalp et l'expertise technique. Maintenir des standards de merchandising visuel et de présentation en boutique. Contribuer aux opérations quotidiennes, y compris les stocks, les livraisons, la reconstitution, les stocks et la manutention des espèces. Ce qui vous aidera à réussir Cette opportunité est pour quelqu'un qui veut développer une vraie carrière dans le commerce de détail haut de gamme et a déjà une première expérience crédible face aux clients. Zermatt est une station balnéaire internationale avec des périodes de pointe exigeantes. La boutique est un environnement pratique où tout le monde contribue aux clients, aux ventes et aux opérations. Must-have Une première expérience réussie face à la clientèle, idéalement dans le commerce de détail, la mode, l'hospitalité haut de gamme ou un autre environnement où le service et les ventes sont centraux. L'anglais est requis. Un véritable intérêt pour la vente, la clientèle et la performance commerciale. Fiabilité, professionnalisme et attitude pratique. Disponibilité pour un contrat saisonnier à 80% et un rota flexible, y compris les week-ends, jours fériés et périodes de pointe. L'allemand est très apprécié. Toute autre langue. Expérience en vente haut de gamme ou de luxe. Ce que vous allez adorer travailler ici Contrat saisonnier à 80% de décembre 2026 au 15 avril 2027. CHF 3800 par mois + bonus. Le salaire est flexible et peut être ajusté en fonction du profil, des qualifications et de l'expérience du candidat. Formation continue des produits et des détaillants. L'occasion de développer votre expérience de vente haut de gamme au sein d'une maison internationale en croissance.
